title: Render the Advisor line into the cell dispatch payload
action: P27's worker advisor consult only fires when the dispatch prompt carries an `Advisor` line, but nothing renders one: packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md has zero advisor mentions, and skills/bee-swarming/references/swarming-reference.md:183 still tells the orchestrator to call `resolveAdvisor(root, runtime)` — a retired JS-era name with no CLI surface. Wire it at the ONE dispatch door instead of leaving a hand step. (1) In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/prepare.rs, for `kind == "cell"` only, resolve the advisor slot with the existing `resolve_advisor` and add an `advisor` render key. Apply the one honest no-op exactly as swarming-reference.md:186-196 states it: no advisor configured -> no key; advisor resolves to LITERALLY the same model name as the worker's resolved model -> no key (a cli-shaped advisor is never the same model, so it is always consulted); otherwise always set it, escalated workers included. The key's value names the advisor identity AND its transport verbatim (model-shaped vs cli-shaped) so it matches what skills/bee-swarming/references/worker-details.md tells the worker to run. (2) In packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md add a `{{#if advisor}}` block rendering that line, placed with the other dispatcher-supplied blocks (near `expertise`). (3) Update the affected payload assertions in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/tests.rs. Do NOT touch the advisor's resolution semantics: decision 4faf1de9 keeps one name and no fall-through, and this cell only decides whether a resolved advisor is NAMED in the payload.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml drivers && bee dev regen && bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: A `bee dispatch prepare --kind cell` payload for a runtime whose configured advisor differs from the worker's resolved model contains an Advisor line naming the advisor identity and its transport.
The same call with no advisor configured contains no Advisor line.
The same call where the advisor resolves to literally the worker's own model name contains no Advisor line.
A cli-shaped advisor always yields an Advisor line, never suppressed by the same-model no-op.
--kind gather, reviewer and advisor payloads are unchanged.
